basic_details.total_vacancies: Junior Superintendent, Junior Engineer (Civil), Junior Engineer (Electrical)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) has advertised three Group B non-teaching posts at Pay Level 6. Junior Superintendent has 3 UR, 2 OBC-NCL and 1 SC vacancies, and Junior Engineer (Civil) and Junior Engineer (Electrical) have 1 UR vacancy each. The upper age limit is 32 years. You apply online on the E-Samarth portal from 29 October 2026 to 28 November 2026 (11:59 PM), and the signed hard copy must reach the Institute by 09 December 2026 (05:30 PM).

application_fee.details: You pay the fee on the portal, and it is not refunded. Regular employees of IIIT Pune do not pay a fee. If you apply for more than one post, you must send a separate application and fee for each post.

age_limit.details: SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms for reserved posts. Contractual and outsourced employees of IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their continuous service in an equivalent post at the Institute, up to a maximum of 10 years, if that service is in the same line or an allied cadre. Regular employees of Central Govt., State Govt., Central Autonomous Bodies, CFTIs, IITs, NITs, IIITs and PSUs with at least 3 years of continuous regular service get up to 5 years, if the post is in the same line or an allied cadre. PwBD reservation and relaxation apply only to persons with 40% or more disability, as defined in DoPT OM No. 36035/02/2017-Estt (Res) dated 15th January 2018. | Read the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for each post before you apply.

how_to_apply: Go to the IIIT Pune E-Samarth recruitment portal and create a login ID and password.
Fill in every field, upload your documents, and save your progress as you go.
Pay the fee online and submit the form. Write down your E-Samarth Form No.; enquiries about lost numbers are not answered.
Print the submitted form, the uploaded documents and the fee receipt.
Number every page, sign and self-attest them, and arrange them in the Annexure-IV order: Cover Page/Index first, then the fee receipt, then the signed form, then your supporting documents.
On the envelope, write "Application for the post of ______" and "E-Samarth Form No. ______".

Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO - Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra - 410507, so it arrives by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. The Institute is not responsible for postal delays.

Once submitted, the online form cannot be changed. Report portal problems to [email protected]. Your form must also give two references, preferably including your most recent employer if you are working.
Application form, signed on every page, with a recent passport-size photograph
Class X certificate showing your date of birth, and Class XII certificate with mark-sheet
UG/PG degree or Ph.D. certificate, as applicable, and mark-sheets for every year or semester
SC/ST certificate, or an OBC-NCL/EWS certificate in Central Government format valid for the current financial year
NOC from your current employer, if applicable, and experience certificates
Photo ID: Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence or Voter ID
Documents cannot be added after the last date. At the Written Test/JoPT, bring all original documents and a signed PDF copy of your online form.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Pune
content_sections.text: IIIT Pune is an Institute of National Importance set up by an Act of Parliament in the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its permanent campus is at Talegaon (Maval), Dist. Pune, Maharashtra - 410507, in the foothills of the Western Ghats. These appointments are governed by the IIIT Act and statutes.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 32 years for all three posts. Your age is checked against the date of birth on your 10th certificate or birth certificate. No other document is accepted. Nationality: Indian nationals can apply, including Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). Essential: First class Bachelor's degree with 6 years of experience in relevant area, OR Post Graduate with 4 years relevant experience. Desirable: Experience in Establishment Matters, Finance and Accounts, Audit, RTI, Stores and Purchase, Administration, Academic matters, Legal matters etc. in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in civil engineering works in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. The notice lists building construction and maintenance, estimation and costing, BOQ and quantity surveying, site supervision, infrastructure development, water supply and sanitation, STP/drainage systems, preparation and interpretation of drawings, contract/work management, quality control, CPWD/PWD specifications, horticulture, basic plumbing and carpentry maintenance, and campus infrastructure maintenance. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in the same types of government bodies listed above. The notice names electrical installation and maintenance, LT/HT distribution systems, transformers, substations, DG sets, UPS and power backup systems, electrical panels and cabling, lighting, earthing, fire alarm/ELV systems, central air-conditioning and HVAC systems, VRF/VRV systems, chillers, AHUs, FCUs, cooling towers, ventilation, ducting, pumps, thermostats and associated control systems, estimation and costing, electrical safety, statutory compliance, contract/work management, and campus electrical infrastructure maintenance. Your qualifications must come from a recognised Board, University or Institute. If you claim an equivalent qualification, you must show proof at document verification. If your university has no CGPA conversion formula or definition of First Class, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA counts as First Class. Only full-time experience counts, and any single period shorter than six months is ignored. Experience certificates must be on official letterhead, signed by the Competent Authority, and must show your designation and pay level or pay. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of online submission. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms for reserved posts. Contractual and outsourced employees of IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their continuous service in an equivalent post

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks every application. If it asks you for more documents or clarifications, you get three working days to send them. The provisional shortlist is posted on the Institute website, and you then have three working days to raise any grievance by email. Admit cards are sent through the portal or to your registered email, usually at least 21 days before the exam. All tests are held at IIIT Pune, Talegaon, and no TA/DA is paid. Domain Knowledge covers the Constitution and government machinery, the Manual of Office Procedure, FRSR, reservation rules, CCS (Leave, CCA, Conduct, Pension) rules, pay fixation, TA and LTC rules, NPS, GPF, GFR 2017, GeM and CPPP, the RTI, RTE, GST, POSH and Arbitration Acts, NEP 2020, ranking frameworks, Sustainable Development Goals, and e-management systems (Samarth, e-Office, IT Act). The Civil syllabus covers building materials, concrete technology, building construction, estimating and valuation, contracts, surveying, geotechnical, transportation, environmental and structural engineering, RCC design and GFR (Works). The Electrical syllabus covers basic concepts, measuring instruments, electrical machines, generation, transmission and distribution, estimation and costing, contracts, utilisation of electrical energy, HVAC, solid waste management and GFR (Works). Every wrong answer in Stage-I loses 1/4 mark. Up to 8 times the number of advertised posts may be shortlisted for Stage-II. The Institute may shortlist more strictly, for example by higher qualifications, more relevant experience, or experience in government bodies. Ties are broken in this order: higher Domain Knowledge marks, then more relevant experience in a Govt. institution, then the older candidate, then alphabetical order of first name. A waitlist panel may be kept for one year.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are on probation for one year and are made regular once they complete it satisfactorily. The probation may be extended. If you work in a government body, PSU or autonomous body, you must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and vigilance clearance with your online form, or bring the NOC to the Written Test/JoPT. Without these, you will not be called for the test.

faq.question: Q1. Is a diploma holder eligible for the IIIT Pune Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. With a Degree in Engineering in the relevant field, 02 years of experience is enough.

faq.question: Q2. How many Junior Superintendent vacancies are there for each category?
faq.answer: There are six: UR-3, OBC-NCL-2 and SC-1. The Junior Engineer (Civil) and Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts have one UR vacancy each.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class for the Junior Superintendent post?
faq.answer: If your university does not define First Class or give a conversion formula, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA is treated as First Class.

faq.question: Q4. Do I have to send a hard copy after applying online?
faq.answer: Yes. The signed, self-attested set must reach the Registrar at PO - Talegaon, Pune - 410507, by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. Eligibility is decided on this hard copy.

faq.question: Q5. Is there negative marking in the written exam?
faq.answer: Yes. Every wrong answer loses 1/4 mark, for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. Do JoPT marks count in the final merit?
faq.answer: For Junior Engineer posts, yes: Stage-I (50) and JoPT (50) are added to make 100. For Junior Superintendent, the JoPT is only qualifying at 50%, and merit is based on the 100-mark written exam.

faq.question: Q7. How much age relaxation do government employees get?
faq.answer: Up to 5 years, for regular employees with at least 3 years of continuous regular service in the same line or an allied cadre. Contractual or outsourced staff at IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their service there, up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but each post needs its own application and fee. For example, a UR candidate pays ₹1,180 per post.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the probation period?
faq.answer: One year. It can be extended before you are made regular.
